messages:
Anya: hey design team — need a compact visual kit for the micro-launch next Tue. Core asks: 3 benchmark tiles (latency / cost / throughput), 1 hero 16:9 slide for the webinar intro, 2 email header variants, and a localisation checklist. Deadline: EOD Fri. Can someone own?

Sam G: sounds good. can we get a brand-safe color option + a grayscale fallback for partner decks? :+1:

Oliver: I can take this. quick q — do the bench tiles need per-region sparklines or just a single global sparkline? also, do we have the latest perf numbers from infra?

Anya: sparklines per-region would be ideal (NA / EU / APAC) — show p95 latency trend. i'll upload a small CSV with the numbers in a sec. also need two copy variants for headings: “Serving wins” and “Inference economics”.

Maria D: legal note: avoid absolute claims about latency improvements unless we have the validated run. prefer approximate signs (≈) or ranges. i’ll review phrasing once you have drafts.

DesignBot: figma file created -> https://redwood.app/figma/microlaunch-kit-1772423141 (components: bench-tile, hero-16x9, email-header, social-square). export tokens pre-configured.

Oliver: perfect — will start with master components. export spec: PNG @2x for social, SVG for icons, and keep source .fig. any translation scope? @Luca

Luca: i can do FR / DE / JP. please provide CSV with copy keys and context strings. prefer separate column for alt-text.

Anya: uploaded copy CSV: https://files.redwood/microlaunch_copy_v2.csv. timeline idea: sketches Wed morning, first draft Thurs, final assets Fri EOD. if blockers, ping me immediately.

Sam G: can we also get a 1:1 square variant derived from the hero for social and a skinny 600x200 for email?

Oliver: yes — adding 1080x1080 and 600x200 export presets. accessibility note: i'll run color-contrast checks and include suggested alt-text in the figma note.

LegalOps: i'll validate copy by Thu morning. flagging any comparative claims — please add a footnote with data-source for the bench tiles.

Anya: also need a very small one-slide storyboard for the webinar (3 bullets + the hero visual). keep it plain so sales can reuse.

Oliver: will draft storyboard slide. uploading first sketch later today and will drop a snapshot here.

Oliver: upload (preview) at 1772423165 — 
```
Preview: hero-sketch.png (attached)
Notes: use Helvetica Neue, weight 600 for headings; tiles use 3-column layout; add small source line under tiles.
```

Anya: looks great. can you add a version with muted brand (lower saturation) for partner co-branded decks?

Oliver: will add muted palette variant and an annotated export checklist in the figma file (filename conventions, sizes, alt-text). example naming: `microlaunch_hero_v1_EN@2x.png`, `bench_tile_latency_FR.svg`.

Luca: will prepare translations as soon as i get the keyed CSV — aiming to return localized files Thu evening.

Maria D: one more legal ask — avoid direct competitor callouts on tiles. keep messaging product-focused.

Anya: noted. thanks everyone. Oliver, drop the figma link + the first drafts in this thread when ready and i'll route to sales & partner ops. :pray:
